name: Jones Residence New

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large primary residence with a complex multi-gable roof and solar panels|A paved driveway curves from the street to a circular turnaround area at the front of the house|A large rectangular swimming pool and an adjacent clay court are located beside the residence|Extensive green lawn surrounds the house|Mature trees and open arid terrain extend outward from the landscaped areas.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows the main facade with a multi-gable roof and covered entry area|A paved circular driveway and turnaround provide vehicle access|Landscaped lawn and mature trees frame the approach|Vehicles are present in the turnaround area.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation with multiple roof sections|Green lawn extends along this side|Mature trees and open arid terrain continue outward|Portions of the swimming pool and clay court are visible toward the rear.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation with large glass openings and outdoor hardscape|Extensive green lawn, the swimming pool, and a clay court are present|Mature trees border the rear perimeter|Open arid terrain extends beyond the landscaped areas.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation with multiple roof sections and solar panels|A paved driveway curves along this side|Green lawn, mature trees, and portions of the swimming pool area are visible|Open arid terrain continues outward.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that curves from the street to a circular turnaround at the front of the residence. The turnaround and driveway offer space for emergency vehicle staging. The swimming pool and clay court provide open hardscape areas at the side and rear. Mature trees are present around the residence and may limit visibility in some sections. Open arid terrain surrounds the landscaped portion of the property. Neighboring residences are present but separated by open ground and vegetation.
clarifications: Is the driveway a through route that continues around the residence, or does it terminate at the circular turnaround?
